svg.title: The Delivery Line
svg.desc: Transit-map diagram of a delivery pipeline. Line 1 runs commit (git, GitHub), build (Jenkins), package (Docker), registry (Amazon ECR), sync (Argo CD, GitOps), run (Kubernetes, Amazon EKS) and observe (Prometheus, Grafana). Line 2, infrastructure as code (Terraform plan and apply), joins at run. A feedback loop returns metrics and alerts to the next commit. An animated train travels the loop.
svg.text: LOOP ◂ METRICS · ALERTS · POSTMORTEMS → THE NEXT COMMIT
